    Distributive Hom spaces and unit rays #

    Package the local Hom-subbimodule form of distributivity used by BGRS. If endpoint-stable submodules form chains and every morphism allows transit or cotransit, local Artinian endpoint rings force principal two-sided spans to classify two-sided unit rays.
